mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL( MAX( SUBSTR( br.bill_number, 13, 4 )), '0000' ) AS maxNum FROM bill_record br WHERE br.org_id = #{orgId} AND DATE_FORMAT(br.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT bpr.id AS billPayRecordId, DATE_FORMAT( bpr.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS chargeDate, bpr.org_id AS orgId, bpr.received_amount AS receivedAmount, bpr.still_owe_amount AS stillOweAmount, bpr.crt_id AS payeeId, bpr.crt_name AS payeeName FROM bill_pay_record bpr WHERE bpr.inservice = 1 and bpr.order_record_id = #{orderRecordId}

SELECT br.patient_id as patientId, ifnull(SUM( br.debt_amount ), 0) AS debtAmount FROM `bill_record` br
br.inservice = 1
and br.patient_id in
#{patientId}
GROUP BY br.patient_id

select br.patient_id as patientId, ifnull(sum(br.receivable_amount), 0) as billTotalOriginalPrice, ifnull(sum(br.privilege_amount), 0) as billTotalPrivilegePrice, ifnull(sum(br.actual_receivable_amount), 0) as billTotalActualPrice, ifnull(sum(br.received_amount), 0) as billTotalReceivedPrice, ifnull(sum(br.debt_amount), 0) as billTotalArrears from bill_record br where br.patient_id = #{patientId} and inservice = true

select br.patient_id as patientId, ifnull(sum(br.receivable_amount), 0) as billTotalOriginalPrice, ifnull(sum(br.privilege_amount), 0) as billTotalPrivilegePrice, ifnull(sum(br.actual_receivable_amount), 0) as billTotalActualPrice, ifnull(sum(br.received_amount), 0) as billTotalReceivedPrice, ifnull(sum(br.debt_amount), 0) as billTotalArrears from bill_record br where inservice = true and br.patient_id in
#{patientId}
